task.title: Duplicate a profile
task.shortdesc: Create a named Guided draft from an existing saved profile when you want a safe starting point for changes.

prereq.p: The source profile is visible in the Library and you have confirmed its row identity.

context.p: Duplicate creates a separate profile draft based on the selected saved profile. It does not change the source profile.

step.cmd: Choose Duplicate on the source profile row.

info.p: Expected result: BPM opens a clone-name panel.

step.cmd: Enter a clear name that differs from existing profile names.

info.p: BPM requires a name and reports duplicate-name validation before confirming.

info.note: A duplicate is separate from the source. Later edits to one profile do not update the other.

result.p: BPM opens or creates the duplicated profile as a named Guided draft or saved profile according to the current workflow.

postreq.p: Recovery: cancel the clone-name panel if the selected source row or new name is wrong.
